# Kautusang Bayan No. 12, Series of 2017

**Prohibition of Structures Occupying One Meter of Land from Road Canals**

## Summary

This ordinance prohibits the construction of any structure occupying one meter of land from the canal of the road within the municipality of Pitogo, Quezon. It aims to ensure the free passage of pedestrians and vehicles, prevent accidents, and maintain accessibility. Violators will be fined.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Article I (Kahulugan):** Defines "side walk" as intended for people walking to their destination.
2.  **Article II:**
    1.  **Section 1 (Basihan):** Based on Batas Pambansa 344, Serye ng Taong 2009 (Enforcement of the Accessibility Law).
    2.  **Section 2:** Orders anyone who owns land facing the road not to place or construct any structure or space/place/area in one meter.
    3.  **Section 3:** Strictly prohibits placing on any structure or space/place/area that obstructs or makes it difficult.
    4.  **Section 4:** Any structure that can be moved that does not hinder can be allowed, with conditions added.
    5.  **Section 5:** If there is any kind of calamity or disaster, the space needed in one meter is considered in the ordinance.
    6.  **Section 6:** The local government may authorize or order the removal of any structure or item.
    7.  **Section 7:** Anyone who violates this Ordinance will be fined Two Thousand Five Hundred Pesos (P 2,500.00).
    8.  **Section 8:** This Ordinance shall take effect upon approval by the [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]].
